study type: randomized controlled trial (analysis within a trial)
outcome: spontaneous fetal version of twin A
spontaneous fetal version of twin B
cohort: Women with twin pregnancies after 32 weeks of gestation, where twin A was vertex, who were part of a multicenter randomized controlled trial on mode of delivery.
finding: The likelihood of spontaneous version for twin A after 32 weeks of gestation is low (3.0%), but much higher for twin B (24.8%), even late in the third trimester, with specific predictors identified for each twin.
